description: The Adventurer is a local errand given by Mountaineer Thalos at the southern gate of Dun Morogh. Before sending travelers through the mountain tunnel…
intro: The Adventurer is a local errand given by Mountaineer Thalos at the southern gate of Dun Morogh. Before sending travelers through the mountain tunnel toward Kharanos, Thalos asks them to carry a bundle of supplies to Eric Brighthammer, a newcomer camped just outside the village.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Wait, friend. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.
My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You say these are from the mountaineers? Aye, I could use them. Thank you, priest.
Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
